notes.title: [Update] v1.2 - Action Update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=xAxe3zIY4SE;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello everyone! ːogupartyː

We've implemented an action update that enhances speed and improves the synergy between skills, reflecting the feedback you've shared through reviews and on [url=https://discord.gg/mdBsKAVfhG]Discord[/url].

Check out the details below!


[h2]Controls[/h2]

[h3]Dash[/h3]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/adbc07916ce091c7a93d00e56ceb54430ad6a4c1.gif[/img]  
After swinging the ladle, press the roll button while moving in the direction you're facing to dash forward.

[h3]Backstep[/h3]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/df5382fd7fdec4ea80422828ce848a1b2d5c6c9f.gif[/img]  
After swinging the ladle, press the roll button without holding the movement key to quickly backstep and evade.

[h3]Roll -> Ladle Swing[/h3]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/d57e0ca31ecd6b1b7041a272cae8ec2dd1132459.gif[/img]  
You can chain a ladle swing while rolling.

[h3]Rolling System Update[/h3]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/398bc528acea929b8b863f92ea5844c5bdab6280.gif[/img]  
The cooldown for rolling has been removed. Additionally, after swinging the ladle, you can now roll in a direction other than where you're facing.

[h3]Headbutt Shield[/h3]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/c97511436ab81d4fb8e21f60368f637ccf4e883e.gif[/img]  
You gain invincibility for the first 1 second while charging a headbutt.

[h3]Headbutt Backstep[/h3]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/5d2bbcfc1fc9075d0f10ded0c1ad3d3739c23d96.gif[/img]  
While charging a headbutt, press the roll button to backstep.

[h3]Critical Hit System Update[/h3]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/39f28f3f56b025d7340ef787af449183a85f6af8.gif[/img]  
You can trigger critical hits more frequently by performing various actions.

[h3]Dancing in Excitement[/h3]  
The time it takes to start dancing when in an excited state has been reduced.

[h3]Invincibility Time After Being Hit[/h3]  
The invincibility time after being hit has been increased from 0.5 seconds to 1 second. Additionally, enemies no longer gain invincibility after being hit.

[h2]Trading Cards & Point Shop[/h2]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/f02791f5726430b8ba771dda82d66fc78d363f34.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/2c1db2533816218d2f0642c42c0774361526b573.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/e555f70a0cb0ed40123d0dcf1a91583c8596de17.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/f56e332b099767ce6e92616ef434cea91336290b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/42489f9e776a99f92214234296d00068ef978b63.png[/img]

Steam trading cards and point shop items have been added. Customize your profile with Ogu and the Secret Forest-themed items!

The Ogu and the Secret Forest Points Shop can be accessed by clicking on the 'Points Shop' tab in the Library, on the Steam launcher.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/6bafb9ea7736223d64fb77280f5a3922e51a63ea.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/a9e597a33e4bd1cefe92bbe08eacf9fb80fdae0a.png[/img]


[h2]System[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/fafa4a0e0351f29a8cb9a211672be831280b3e3e.gif[/img]  
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Baby Ogu would get stuck on the edge of obstacles.
[*] Adjusted the colliders of some boss monsters.
[/list]

[h2]Graphics[/h2]

[list]  
[*] Improved the swinging motion of Baby Ogu's ladle.  
[*] Enhanced hit effects.  
[*] Improved the effects when enemies take damage.  
[/list]

[h2]Content[/h2]

[list]  
[*] Some totems’ abilities have been adjusted due to control changes.  
[*] After clearing Esmeralda's museum quest, the location of the antique shop is now marked on the map.  
[/list]

[h2]System[/h2]
You can now toggle the controller quick menu on/off in the options.

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
Fixed an issue where enemies hit by Baby Ogu's swing would be pulled towards Baby Ogu while facing backward.




We hope this update enhances your experience in *Ogu and the Secret Forest* with more thrilling and enjoyable gameplay.

Thank you! ːogudanceː

notes.title: [Update] v1.1 - Random Encounters & QOL
notes.content:
Hello! ːsteamhappyː

We’re excited to introduce the update notes for version 1.1, which includes various new content and quality-of-life improvements.

[previewyoutube=VAuComRGSso;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]Cutscenes Added[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/feb63fc987a5b2ba4748a6ff7a7e146267a911f3.gif[/img]

A total of 9 area entrances and key in-game moment cutscenes have been added.
We plan to add a feature that will allow players to rewatch the in-game cutscenes in the future.


[h2]Divine Beast Rooms[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/07a2337be1d6e9ead35104ec9c327707bfc562e4.gif[/img]

We've added [b]'Divine Beast Rooms'[/b], random encounters that help players collect jewelss, top-tier fish, regional insects, and various cores. You can find 'Divine Beast Rooms' across the world, and by offering items at the shrines, different interactions become available based on the item type.

[h3]<If you’ve met Batt and have jewel crafting tools>[/h3]
[list]
[*] Offer common minerals or jewels to access a room with every type of gem.
[*] You can acquire 1 jewel but if you spend 1 jewel to the shrine, you can acquire 2 jewels.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/07643e8853b1582d8eada52900ba46d7252cb79e.png[/img]

[h3]<If you’ve met Enki>[/h3]
[list]
[*] Offer bait or fish to access a room where all top-tier fish appear.
[*] You can catch 1 fish, or 2 fish if you spend a top-tier fish to the shrine.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/4d43c377060cb675599dc072a7e08196c0b91ac7.png[/img]

[h3]<If you’ve met Rahno>[/h3]
[list]
[*] Access a room where all types of regional insects appear.
[*] You can catch 1 insect, or 2 insects if you offer a region-exclusive insect.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/156f9dc6216e7f23365f323ce7a1ff6a91f4ddbe.png[/img]

[h3]Other Encounters[/h3]
[list]
[*] Offering cooking ingredients(except fishes), upgrade materials, or cores will summon a monster that drops Filthy or Fallen Cores with a 100% success rate.
[*] Normally, 1 monster will be summoned, but offering a Filthy or Fallen Core will summon 2 monsters. [/list]

In the Divine Beast Rooms, you'll encounter rare collectibles in one place, but obtaining the desired item will require some skill.

Additionally, the more you explore, the higher the chance of encountering a Divine Beast Room.


[h2]Newspapers[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/ad42d5bacc00ad08bd25e179bf997bac7a5e355b.png[/img]

You can now buy newspapers from the consumable merchants in each village.
Using a newspaper provides information about items exclusive to that region.

[i]* If you already know all the information, nothing will happen![/i]


[h2]Shell Game[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/122d0b5a976ab0e070b7fcd6fa22c1d4cf59417a.gif[/img]

A new mini-game called 'Shell Game' has been added as a random encounter, where you can obtain dish for your adventure journal. By paying a small fee, you can collect dish and fill up your journal.

If you’ve already completed the food section of the journal, you will receive a All-in-One Cooking Kit as a reward.



[h2]Cooking Restoration Device[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/2a07e7b28f9630b3d1fa284dc66f40c9a4138489.gif[/img]

A random encounter has been added that allows you to turn failed items('Food' or 'Food Waste') into random dishes. This encounter can be used [b]3 times[/b] when found.



[h2]Improved Menu Accessibility (Controller)[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/5a3aad61cb82765cec6e29578794aa08f476257d.gif[/img]

We’ve added interactions to allow controller users to more easily navigate through menus and the adventure journal


[h2]Puzzle Hint Addition & Accessibility Improvements[/h2]

Hints have been added to certain puzzles, and for those that require observation of small objects, we've added areas that zoom in on the screen to improve visibility.


Even after this update, additional updates are planned to make the gameplay experience more convenient and enriching. Please look forward to it!

notes.title: [Patch Note] 1.0 ~ 1.0.3
notes.content:
Hello!

We are pleased to introduce the patch notes from the v1.0 update on July 29 to today's v1.0.3 update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/bd2e6bdb16cd1d31ef5a0985068356df83f49e2f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/8bf6c5bbbaa144ca920400860ec5cd5d21342a7c.gif[/img]

[h3]2. UI Category Navigation[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/f72e05533b05d230afff96705bfc3106b16d509c.gif[/img]

In joystick environments, you can navigate directly to intermediate categories using the special interaction keys. The default settings are LT / RT.

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where DLC hats could not be obtained even after purchasing the DLC.
[*] Fixed an issue where turrets would not spawn properly in the desert area.
[*] Fixed an issue where the telescope did not function correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue where the mayor in the snowy region would freeze after taking damage.
[*] Fixed an issue where some puzzles in the Moon Forest would cause a game over simultaneously upon completion.
[*] Fixed an issue where entries in the Adventure Journal would sometimes display incorrectly.
[*] Fixed an issue where continuing from game over was not possible if joystick key settings were configured in certain ways.
[/list]

[h2]Enhancements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved the visibility of the dowsing hat effects.
[/list]

[h2]UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where progress was not displayed correctly in the save slots.
[*] Updated the map image of the snowy village.
[/list]

[h2]Maps[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the southern cliff of the Miner’s Hot Springs was passable.
[/list]

[h2]Localization[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where some Japanese characters were not displayed correctly.
[*] Corrected translation errors in certain Japanese hint texts.
[/list]

Thank you for your support and encouraging messages for our official release.
We will continue to strive for a better gaming experience.

Thank you!

notes.title: [Dev Log] Summer Sale & Official Release
notes.content:
Hello! ːsteamhappyː

We are working hard for the official release on July 29th.

Currently, "Ogu and the Secret Forest" is on a [b]15% discount[/b] during the Steam Summer Sale, which will be the last discount before the official release. If you haven't purchased "Ogu and the Secret Forest" yet, consider doing so now!

The major issues we're working on are the [b]final battle and ending[/b], which are still under wraps, and improving the convenience of existing content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/80456a45fdbaf4e8416306d91439d05f6d6bb843.png[/img]

To avoid spoilers about the final battle, here are some improvements you'll see in the official release:


[h2]1. Display of Fish Species at Fishing Spots[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/eeef5da0a7ff8792a360b6ef81bc1afe28e89b16.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/2ebf570b6402a031f35af7d383a95a1b70c021ec.gif[/img]

New signs will be placed at each fishing spot, showing the types of fish that appear there. Fish you have caught before will be highlighted.


[h2]2. Cooking System Changes[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/d0b114bd4b90fb8e6a07e825e408641a99b8a09b.gif[/img]

The cooking system has been improved as follows:

[h3]When There is No Recipe[/h3]
Selecting ingredients not in a recipe will now [b]not proceed with cooking[/b] and will display a message indicating that there is no related recipe.

[h3]Cooking Gauge and Extra Rewards[/h3]
A gauge showing the progress of the cooking process has been added.
[list]
[*] If the gauge is very low at the end of cooking, [b]food waste[/b] is created.
[*] If the gauge is low, [b]food[/b] is created.
[*] If the gauge is normal or above, a [b]dish[/b] is created.
[*] If the gauge is very high, [b]2 dishes[/b] are created.
[/list]


[h2]3. Sold Out[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/cb8c8bc58f563a2ae7a27bb13ddd77b99593e1cd.gif[/img]

When all items are purchased from shops that sell limited items like equipment and interior goods, the shop shutters will close.


[h2]4. Sun Village Telescope[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/37c137350a126b8a00f042688f6cd39fd1afda13.gif[/img]

Looking through the telescope at the Sun Village observatory, you can now see the scenery that was previously displayed as text.


[h2]5. Baby Ogu Dance[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/baf435d760d57cb8dbd25f5e18700b1a2a95799b.gif[/img]

If you don't control Baby Ogu for a certain period, he will dance in place.



We will continue to provide updates on development and release news until the official launch.

Please look forward to the official release on July 29th!

notes.title: 0.6.2 Patch Note & Dev Log
notes.content:
Hi!

We've released version 0.6.2 with some bug fixes and development progress towards a full release. Here are the details.


[h2]Change the loading screen[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/93083d7624f9cc119518c46ea22ed8324a85f82a.png[/img]

The loading screen when loading the game from the main screen has been changed to the image of the world map that was also featured in the trailer.


[h2]The Pier Way[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/4d09b6ac045e7bc4bca02be7c818cb3415bbca6b.png[/img]

The Pier Way is currently changing. We've added a fishing deck and a bait vendor to the empty area, and will be adding an atelier where Maltese works.
(The fish species in the fishing deck above are the same as the fishing pier in the hermit crab village).


[h2]Depth Effect[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/7c6aafc38ea81e45f81e5569b0588c27b216f36c.gif[/img]

We are adding ceiling objects that add depth to the caves and rooms.
Currently, you can only find them in the Cave area of the Jungle, but they will be added to all relevant areas at v1.0.


[h2]Bard[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/8ae916772a0fb52000a9a3196fa425b26845b1cf.png[/img]

notes.content:
Hello!

I'm excited to share the development status of the final additional content that will be updated at the end of this month. This update includes all the remaining unreleased areas and content except for the final battle.

[h2]Road of Proof[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/4c67f4b248311bbde7b549eefd6f054129606225.png[/img]

The map related to the "Sigil of the Tree', which was previously inaccessible in the main quest, will be revealed.

The 'Road of Proof', accessible from the south of the Central Forest, is where the teachers who taught baby Ogu gather. This path leads to the final battle location, so the teachers will check if baby Ogu is ready to face the final boss.

[h2]Central Cave[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/108e7f07b79782981ef95ea3f047288300fe29c9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/53a3365fef839e7284eeb59050d317bba370fc72.png[/img]

The Central Cave, connecting various parts of the Central Forest, will be revealed.

In the Central Cave, you will be able to mine two types of gems that were previously unobtainable and encounter trash monsters and puzzles related to the overall story of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/542f6466e216cc0e73336e2103f231c80f21d7d9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/d3fe4e2ae197f84a285f7727e193c2db976a4a23.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/732fa285285179bff2972909ed35fc7aa9683552.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/371492cd349224d02d5f77f32d563f6394487734.png[/img]

The quests and related areas of the Apple Woods, leading from the southwestern world to Hermit Crab Village, will be revealed. Small quests involving 'Panpan', who runs the orchard, as well as the mountain path connected to the Apple Forest and Bee Village, will be updated.

[h2]Harbor Town Quest[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/e12bf2862b53ea5d9d559c911915592406c0f5c5.png[/img]

A small quest will be added to Harbor Town.

The northern area of Sky Island and the ruins of the Moon Forest Cave will become accessible. Additionally, about 20 new Piece of Artifact will be added to complete all museum collections.

Thank you to everyone who has supported us, and we will do our best to ensure a successful official launch.

Thank you!

Skills have been added to about 20 hats that previously had no functions, and upgrade stages have been introduced.
The list of hats with changes includes:

[list]
[*] Warrior's Mask
- Changed to gain an increase in attack power instead of increasing critical hit rate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/8f1637506659db2ec0c79b84a2a7b819ff0396d8.gif[/img]

- Occasionally obtain salt from enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/1bbca4c07d8ced573f6b4f0a0f27e818f78dcd43.gif[/img]

- Summons a ghost shark to attack enemies.

- Instead of slowing nearby enemies, it summons an area at the headbutt-strike point that slows enemies.

- Increases maximum health by 5 only in Snowland regions.

- Sounds become muffled.

- Summons weeds depending on the surrounding terrain.

- Makes a funny sound.

- An upgrade stage has been added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/3969f4151a0186134b2d72a76f79b376a8d42fcc.png[/img]

- A new hat obtained from the Temple of Dance, changes the background music and produces cool effects when dancing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/0c7eb5d6e116980b08c362ee381b89cc230d2692.png[/img]

- A new hat obtained from Dusky Town, can make underwear shine when getting close to panty bugs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/980fb8ff419331bd1aad3a58572d4e3f0c6ad6dc.png[/img]

- A new hat obtained from Penguin Island, can make you look like a penguin.

Most areas that were previously inaccessible have been unlocked, and content has been added.

[h3]Jungle[/h3]

[b]- Trial of the Waterfall[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/c2242246aec9b0e8ed421439454de48704078009.png[/img]

A small dungeon with puzzles and a new sub-boss.

[b]- Temple of Dance[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/490e30f7ff004faaf30d5dca5c5e34c4fde00704.png[/img]

A dungeon with puzzles and a new sub-boss.

[b]- Outskirts of the Jungle Dungeon[/b]
A small dungeon consisting of one map.

[h3]Moon Forest[/h3]

[b]- Dusky Town[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/55b4fdaaeaa80edef066b12b92a79d7bb15dc521.png[/img]

An area with a short sub-quest line. You can enjoy a mini-game of tennis.

[h3]Sea[/h3]

[b]- Lantern Fish Cave[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/9ccf5ff93114608c2f300220aa2ee17dcfc2f224.png[/img]

A cave with a new sub-boss.

[b]- Temple of Cooking[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/d32c0c05c2a1ce97046e56d93e1a9ec011fb1e2b.png[/img]

A temple consisting of a single puzzle.

[b]- Penguin Island[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/3c9db9165fae8bff7a970fa0d00e5100e7a9ddc1.png[/img]

A map where you can solve mysteries with cute penguins.

A map with quests and a new sub-boss.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/11175c4cd4828f193e34c9541ff532cc6c385f9e.png[/img]

Changed to a notation that shows progress, current health, and gold possession.

[h3]Collectible System Improvement[/h3]
- When you obtain a new collectible, it is immediately displayed when opening the adventure journal.

- If you see text related to that collectible, like making a call to a friend, the information is updated in the adventure journal.



[h2]System[/h2]

- The gold acquisition from overall game content has been adjusted, and accordingly, the value of items and quest rewards have changed.

- The variety of items sold by village merchants has been expanded.

- If you recover health beyond the maximum with food, you gain a cheerful state for 3 seconds per amount recovered.




We will work hard to develop more fun and polished content for the official release.

Thank you!

notes.title: [Dev Log] Additional Content and advanced systems
notes.content:
Hello! 😊

Before we prepare for the final journey to the Sigil of the Tree content, we're currently wrapping up the blocked-off sections and hidden content in the areas released so far.

Accordingly, the next update will include many maps and various mid-bosses, along with mini-games and puzzles, even though it is not a new area update.

Please check out the key contents below!


[h2]Trial of the Waterfall[/h2]
As some of you may know, there is a hidden space behind a waterfall somewhere in the Village of the Sun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/a90db3ea8f83b78e45c6e8a1e824348d8264ed2d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/c2242246aec9b0e8ed421439454de48704078009.png[/img]

Fittingly named 'Trial of the Waterfall,' behind this waterfall lies a challenging puzzle involving 'pushing' mechanics and a hidden boss that you would never have imagined.


[h2]Temple of Dance[/h2]

Somewhere in the eastern jungle is a hidden temple dedicated to the study of the monkey's dance.
What could possibly happen in this scary yet exciting place?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/490e30f7ff004faaf30d5dca5c5e34c4fde00704.png[/img]


[h2]Dusky Town and the Tennis Match[/h2]
The path at the entrance of the Moon Forest Village that many of you have been curious about is set to open.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/5ec320545281c01746cad0b7e4c5bd88b238844a.png[/img]

Taking advantage of the chaos caused by the corrupted Silk Worm Warrior, a bug named 'Blanc' wearing white shorts is ruling over the Dusky Town.
What will happen in Dusky Town, where tennis is loved?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/55b4fdaaeaa80edef066b12b92a79d7bb15dc521.png[/img]

[h2]Anglerfish Cave and Temple of Cuisine[/h2]
You'll be able to play the hidden temple and Anglerfish Cave in the latter part of the sea area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/d32c0c05c2a1ce97046e56d93e1a9ec011fb1e2b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/9ccf5ff93114608c2f300220aa2ee17dcfc2f224.png[/img]

In the temple, you can acquire a new sea area hat, and in the cave, you'll meet a new mid-boss.

[h2]Penguin Island[/h2]

In the southern part of the Snowfield, you'll find an island full of penguins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/3c9db9165fae8bff7a970fa0d00e5100e7a9ddc1.png[/img]

Solve the creepy mystery hidden among the adorable penguins!

[h2]Tucker's House[/h2]

On the western path of the Central Forest, there is a secluded cabin.
There, you can meet Tucker, who is researching the trash monsters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/8f4541bdd2755d93b1778a006346ea26ac81027d.png[/img]

[h2]Town Portal[/h2]

Before facing all the bosses, a portal that allows for quick travel to the nearest village will be added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/1df46b060977474f7de533030c60228610434c21.png[/img]

If the boss battle is tricky, return to the village to heal and buy items that will help in combat before challenging again!

[h2]Additional Features for Hats[/h2]

Various functions are planned to be added to the hats that have not had specific features so far.
Stay tuned!

[h2]Value Adjustment for Mini-Games and Items[/h2]

The rewards for mini-games, which were low compared to playtime and difficulty, are set to increase.
With the adjustments in the value of in-game content, the values of items will also be revised.




The update is scheduled for the third week of March.
We hope many of you will enjoy 'Ogu and the Secret Forest' even more with the preparations we've made.

Thank you!

notes.content:
Hello! ːsteamhappyː

We've been quite busy over the past couple of months for preparing two game shows. Furthermore, we're in the thick of developing for our next game update. Also, just today, we rolled out a small update introducing the 'Restaurant' management and parts of the totem system.

Please check out the details below!


[h2]Restaurant[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/5475b0e683bb0b2a8db8c0ab5c620705c3763042.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/43b701a065fc65aba82f4fd368d8383fb77b4394.png[/img]

You can run the restaurant for a day by selecting four dishes for which you know the recipes. Serving more expensive dishes can earn you more money, but they also take longer to prepare. Customers will get impatient and leave the restaurant if made to wait for too long, so it's crucial to balance your menu appropriately.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/67c97348cc8990714505842daef6ad87672f8f6c.png[/img]

Additionally, each restaurant has its regular customers.
If you serve dishes that contain ingredients these customers favor, you can receive tips!

[list]
[*] Olive Restaurant: Salt, Century Plant, Grade 1 & 2 Fish, Piranha
[*] Gordon Restaurant: Grade 1 & 2 Herbs, Grade 1 & 2 Roots, Light Reed Leaf
[/list]

In the restaurant, we sell items that can skip the cooking process, and they are also awarded as bonuses at the end of the operation. These will be particularly helpful when making a large number of dishes or when cooking with expensive ingredients.

To operate a restaurant, you'll need a recommendation from the chefs of each restaurant, Olive and Gordon.
[i]* If you've previously met Olive and Gordon and completed their quests, you will automatically receive their recommendation upon starting the game. Please take note![/i]

notes.content:
Hi, All! ːsteamhappyː

The 'Harbor Town' content has been updated.
If you haven't seen the trailer yet, please check out the video below!

▼ Harbor Town Trailer
[previewyoutube=tS8EAGwFM90;full][/previewyoutube]

▼ Harbor Town's main BGM
[previewyoutube=OB1QCxiu2cw;full][/previewyoutube]


Here are the new content and improved features added in this update


[h1]New Content[/h1]

[h2]Main Questline[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/211c81f454e0f32ecc06ab1377b7b1cf4071b658.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/71d45f5cc4f8c118fbefead5d1ed2ae0e067395b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/b33eef1f6da9cacf7520750b5d41c0c3714f1bb7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/47976cc752f3a5caf4733e6b9ada5da56387be3f.png[/img]

- Embark on an adventure with the sailor 'Kenin' in the largest village, Harbor Town, in "Ogu and the Secret Forest!"
- The main quest in Harbor Town consists of various mini-games and content such as infiltration, sailing, dungeons, and bosses.


[h2]Drill Hat & Treasure Hunt[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/940543ce7a19d2043d1ef876e757fece5547088f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/4d4829473d503786b951e0b68cec7fb4d7b6a1d1.png[/img]

- Dig the ground with a drill hat and discover clay of different colors and items in each area.
- Acquire a treasure map from the antique shop and restore artifacts in the museum.


[h2]Artifact Recovery & Opening the Museum[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/f450d8ce16c0bbfb1ad5ac9072ef7f955da6f2d7.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/97b1477c9fabc9728f6b7720c51c85327deec640.png[/img]

- Open the museum and welcome visitors! The more exhibits you have, the more visitors you will attract.
- Use artifact fragments obtained from treasure hunting to restore artifacts. When you restore artifacts, visitors who give gifts will come to the museum.



[h2]Making Pottery[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/26c3df715a5835950c00e65f9194982606744002.png[/img]

- Learn pottery-making techniques at the pottery workshop in Harbor Town.
- Change pottery designs from around the world and deliver them to the residents of Harbor Town.



[h2]Underground Arena[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/c103f81d9857ed037ec6c04b2a1db35741747669.png[/img]

- Challenge powerful enemies that embody the characteristics of various regions such as the jungle, desert, and moon forest.
- Be especially cautious as your health is limited!
- If you fill up the honor score in the arena, you can receive special rewards.



[h2]Interior Items[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/dea4b3c5552b50cc143c1411b2893a69eeecd81b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/1085451371c96c4cbfb2b6a222fe1537c011d023.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/a45d58443a55bafbb5ce459e156c94758d954919.png[/img]

- Use the designer robot, newly added to the hero's house, to change the interior design such as wallpaper, flooring, and lighting.
- You can purchase interior items from the merchants in each village.



[h1]Revised[/h1]

[h2]Jigsaw Puzzle System[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/95f864f976b3d07063b51cc2ddf2dbe4dd3a53b4.gif[/img]

 - The puzzle-solving method, such as pushing puzzle pieces one by one, like puzzles in the Moon Forest has been changed.


[h2]Interior List[/h2]

- With the increase in interior items, the construction of interior now allows you to view the item list as a menu when selecting items.


[h2]Important Keyword Coloring[/h2]

 - Important keywords in the text are highlighted in yellow. The keyword highlighting will gradually expand as updates progress.


[h2]Multiple Selection[/h2]

- When selecting multiple items in cooking, museum exhibitions, and various quests, you can make multiple selections at once.



The restoration of museum artifacts and opponents in the arena will continue to be added to the Harbor Town content in the future.

Thank you for playing and we appreciate your continued support and anticipation! 😊

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/603cdb3bd94829d6700c4edc2ff8ab45eb14e4cc.png[/img]

Hello! ːsteamhappyː

The new sector, 'Harbor Town' will be updated next Wednesday.

We are currently conducting final testing and wrapping up trailer and banner images, and content will continue to be gradually added even after the update.

The updated contents will include:


[h2]Harbor Town & Thunder Island[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/211c81f454e0f32ecc06ab1377b7b1cf4071b658.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/71d45f5cc4f8c118fbefead5d1ed2ae0e067395b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/b33eef1f6da9cacf7520750b5d41c0c3714f1bb7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/47976cc752f3a5caf4733e6b9ada5da56387be3f.png[/img]

Harbor Town is located in the southern part of the world, and Early Access users can enter through the southwestern entrance at adventurer's camp.

While Harbor Town doesn't have any sigil, it does have a main questline that is related with other areas. This questline consists of infiltration, mini-games, dungeons, and various other content. Uncover the secrets intertwined with Harbor Town alongside the small sailor, Kenin!


[h2]Making Pottery[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/26c3df715a5835950c00e65f9194982606744002.png[/img]

In the pottery workshop of Harbor Town, you can create pottery. The pottery you make can be customized to your desired shape, and it can also be used to solve quests within the town or change the appearance of pottery placed throughout the world.


[h2]Drill Hat & Treasure Map[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/940543ce7a19d2043d1ef876e757fece5547088f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/4d4829473d503786b951e0b68cec7fb4d7b6a1d1.png[/img]

You can use the newly added "Drill Hat" to excavate items from the ground. Not only can you find clay for pottery making, but you can also purchase a treasure map from the antique shop to discover artifact fragments for restoring museum artifacts.



[h2]Restoring Artifact & Opening the Museum[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/f450d8ce16c0bbfb1ad5ac9072ef7f955da6f2d7.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/97b1477c9fabc9728f6b7720c51c85327deec640.png[/img]

The artifact fragments obtained through treasure hunting are used to restore newly added artifacts in the museum. When an artifact is restored, you will receive immediate rewards or NPC visitors who bring gifts will come to the museum.

In addition, by completing certain quests in the Harbor Town, you can open the museum and welcome visitors. Different visitors will come depending on the items exhibited, and more will be added in the future!



[h2]Arena[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/c103f81d9857ed037ec6c04b2a1db35741747669.png[/img]

In the underground of the Harbor Town, there exists an underground arena that values honor and duels. The underground arena is a combat content where the honor score changes based on the player's performance, and it is characterized by playing with limited health depending on the difficulty of each opponent.

Currently, there are a total of 9 challenge opponents themed around the jungle, moon forest, and desert, and they will be updated together with the addition of new sectors


[h2]Improvement of Jigsaw Puzzle Mechanics[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/95f864f976b3d07063b51cc2ddf2dbe4dd3a53b4.gif[/img]


We have made a change to the gameplay mechanics of the jigsaw puzzle. Instead of pushing individual pieces, we have improved it by implementing a method where players can move the puzzle pieces as if they were placing objects in a home decoration activity.



[h2]Interior Change[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/1085451371c96c4cbfb2b6a222fe1537c011d023.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/dea4b3c5552b50cc143c1411b2893a69eeecd81b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/a45d58443a55bafbb5ce459e156c94758d954919.png[/img]


Players now can change the interior of the hero's house. By replacing interior items, such as flooring, wallpaper, lighting, and particles are changed according to item's themes. These interior items can be purchased from the shops in each village, and additional items will be added as quest rewards in the future.



Thank you for your interest in the Harbor Town update.
We appreciate your support, and we look forward to showcasing the upcoming trailer once it's completed. Please stay tuned for more updates, and we'll be sure to keep you informed.

Thanks!!! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: [Harbor Town] Dev Log 3 & Roadmap Change
notes.content:
Hello! ːsteamhappyː

We are continuously preparing the content for the Harbor Town update, which is scheduled for late June to early July. The major structure of the update, including the map and main questline, has been fully planned, and we are now adding detailed elements such as side quests and immersive features.

Below is a preview of the maps that have been developed so far.


[h1]Upcoming Update Maps[/h1]
* If you don't want to see a preview of the upcoming content and prefer to wait until the update, please scroll down!




[h2]Frog Field[/h2]

This is a large map that can be explored before entering the Harbor Town. It features several puzzles and side quests to engage with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/b1cfbaa9e9b543f2a9ac5b543cfa66bbc1717cbb.png[/img]


[h2]Northern Harbor Town[/h2]

You will encounter a map with a bridge that leads to Harbor Town. You can also spot the headquarters of Soong Soong Express.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/1796aa3e584f2828e920995f9806a7c4caa59275.png[/img]


[h2]Harbor Town[/h2]

Main Stage of this update, it is the largest and most densely packed map among the ones developed so far, being 1.5 times the size of Sun Village.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/09080ce152fe823aa7ca5c1a71e631dd194544cb.gif[/img]

As it will encompass various contents such as a pottery workshop, a restaurant, an antique shop, and an arena, we are putting a lot of effort into its creation, aiming to unveil it in the most splendid form possible.


[h2]Cargo Ship[/h2]

This is the place where a covert infiltration mission takes place, requiring you to stealthily steal items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/34fe0a33ae4820dadbbd156b85258f2a67baf73f.png[/img]


[h2]Arena[/h2]

This is a challenging location where you have to face tough enemies with limited health. There are three stages prepared for each area, featuring enhanced versions of previously encountered enemies and introducing new enemies with unfamiliar patterns.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/4a2dc5d4f2d39aba5450f3fe0df756d9e93fadfa.png[/img]


[h1]Updated Early Access Roadmap[/h1]

[*] The development order of the Snow region and the Water region has been changed.

Please refer to the image below for more details. We have also updated the Steam store page with this information.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/55233abfafafce91a490cfc740ac299729a88ff2.png[/img]

notes.title: Q&A Answers!
notes.content:
Hello!ːsteamhappyː
We’ve assembled questions that you guys asked last week!


[h2]Q. How long is the playtime of the game?[/h2]

In this current build, we have three main regions to play and the playtime will be around 5 hours to clear.

Single region contains about 1.5 hours of playtime, thus all six regions after the full release will have an estimate of 10 hours of game playtime.

However, this is only if you play the main storyline and not the additional contents such as sub quests, housing and collecting various collectibles. That’s going to take a lot longer than the main storyline.


[h2]Q. What’s the cost of the game?[/h2]

The early access of the ‘Ogu and the Secret Forest’ will be 17.99 USD. The cost will increase when the game is fully released.


[h2]Q.Will there be any hidden hats ... ?![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/7e9252ae02d5ddbe7785ca4de2a3c21b755c6989.png[/img]

Yeah! There are many hidden hats throughout the game. Some are sold in shops however, some may only be acquirable through secret discovery. There will be more hats to come!

[h2]Q. What is the origin of ‘Baby Ogu’? Is Ogu from the stars?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/f3c65c45410f5fcad33eebf21cf287042feb447e.png[/img]


[h2]Q. Is multiplayer going to be featured in the game?[/h2]

‘Ogu and the Secret Forest’ is a single player adventure game.
Multiplayer is not available in the game.

[h2]Q. How old is ‘Baby Ogu’? lol[/h2]

59000 years old.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/9cbd8ea4d3f7c2725ef02cce0ea0b380f74ec22a.png[/img]



[h2]Q. Can we hear the characters' voices?[/h2]

Our main character ‘Baby Ogu’ is a silent protagonist. We wanted the players to imagine what the characters might sound like.

Also creating more than 100 unique characters’ voices might cause some difficulties to the creation process. This is why we decided not to include voices for the characters.

[h2]Q. Will there be more language supports?[/h2]

Currently, ‘Ogu and the Secret Forest’ is supporting Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese (Traditional and Simplified). During the 1 year period of early access, we’ll try our best to include language support for more countries.

[h2]Q. What do you want the players to feel playing this game?[/h2]

We want the players to feel nostalgic. The feeling of the joy and pure curiosity we felt when we played video games when we were younger. But most of all, we want everyone to enjoy it!

notes.title: [Dev Journal 2] Conceptualizing and Planning of the Jungle Region
notes.content:
Hello! ːsteamhappyː

  Today we’ll introduce you to the starting area of the game. This is how we started the creation of the ‘Jungle Region’.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/606c0915a6461b52c577c18d9634cca54c99f2e6.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=2BLmJIEzz_o;full][/previewyoutube]


  The north east area of the world is the Jungle region. This area is divided in two which includes the [b]Starting Area[/b], where you start your journey, and the [b]Jungle Outskirt[/b] where the story builds up.


  Since this is where we make the first impression of the game, we wanted to create an area where it is full of visual interests along with some fairly simple puzzles and combat scenarios that will introduce the players to the gameplay.

[h2]Waterfall of the Meditating Monkey[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/b6b5be24b53b3bf97a4a1247101e78880f1b123a.gif[/img]

The Village of the Sun’s residents, the monkeys, have a deep respect towards nature and are living in harmony with it. Also they always train their minds for peace and clarity by meditation.
You can occasionally encounter these meditating monkeys at the Waterfall in front of the village.

[h2]Temple of the Sun[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/adc31d16927f20915a511d72d9fde83002ad352f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/ef6c3f166522cf0055a7cdffecdfa4f037573d56.png[/img]

  At the ‘Temple of the Sun’ lies the ‘Sigil of the Sun’. One of the 6 broken pieces of the world.
  The monkeys are waiting for the chosen one from their folklore to arrive and bring harmony back to the world. They have found one of the broken pieces and are keeping it safe for the rightful hero’s arrival.

To visually represent these thematic concepts, we’ve tried to incorporate the architectural style of the ancient magnificent and mysterious ‘Angkor Wat’ as a reference.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/7a6ddf7285a38cdd15e9db8223bf65820e9d986e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/fa2286bcfaa74a6a9794d5bfa6e633f32bb7253c.png[/img]

  ‘The Temple of the Sun’ is the first dungeon that the player will come across. We’ve tried to represent the classic adventure-game style dungeon that we all love. It also introduces to the players the hints of core mechanics of puzzles and combat. We designed the dungeon so that it represents few of the core gameplay mechanics.

  Before, the dungeon only contained puzzles until you encountered the boss. However, we thought that this wasn’t enough of a representation of our game play. This is why we redesigned the dungeon so that it has more combat scenarios including the ‘Monkey Sentinel’ fight.

[h2]Village of the Sun[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/d38ad6bb8de55ec1e0552fdc3e250f734ad5a8ba.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/37f032a5e29fc0705a7b503f93645b51c34bfc48.gif[/img]

  ‘Village of the Sun’ is the first town that you’ll come across adventuring in the vast world of  secret forest. This is the biggest map so far out of approximately 200 maps that exist in the game right now. There are various NPCs including Merchants, Quests and information givers, Fishing tutorial guy and also people that just wanna have a little chat with our protagonist ‘Baby Ogu’. There is also another important aspect to this town. The ‘Hero’s House’.

[h2]Hero’s House[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/9d47a69da43faafc5db8792476ddc16deb8dafbd.png[/img]

  Early design of the ‘Hero’s House’ was a simple area where you can visit throughout the adventure to replenish various expendables and maybe harvest some crops and upgrade some gears. However, since we created more interactable objects including hotspring, upgrade station, cooking campfire and chairs just to name a few, we wanted the ‘Hero’s House’ to be able to be customized to the player’s liking. This is why we implemented the housing system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/35dbf8eae9cb8d4b0653d0f73a667395036fedc4.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/37c514166c84ec594f5e0ecb46d720716decf5f7.gif[/img]

  Housing system was developed and implemented during the 3rd closed beta test and still is under construction to be refined. We’re currently developing more furniture and objects so that you can have a unique home. Until early access, we’ll implement as much as we can.

Next, we’ll talk about the ‘Moon Forest’.
See you soon!

notes.title: Demo Update & Development Progress
notes.content:
Hello everyone! ːsteamhappyː
Hope you’ve all spent a wonderful new year.

We’ve been hard at work for the early access release this March.
After this version update on the demo, we’ll soon begin the 3rd closed beta test. (Korea Exclusive)

These are the updates for the demo version and the current development.



[h2]1. Demo Version Updates[/h2]

[h3]Monkey Sentinel[/h3]
A lot of people suggested that the amount of puzzles in the beginning area was overwhelming. So we’ve decided to include a new combat for the ‘Monkey warehouse’ and ‘The Temple of the Sun’ by including a new adversary.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/43bccd08fdc24973a4e420310e604a0029411474.gif[/img]

The monkey sentinel will be using the rock fist ability similar to the sun golem’s attack.
During movement it will not take any damage however when it’s stationary, it will. The monkey sentinel will be stationary for it to engage the attack. So that’s when you may strike it.


[h3]Additional Garbage Monsters[/h3]
The Temple of the Sun has more enemies for combat now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/b6e985a1f31c12dcc0ca420a9eb157f63ff47c37.png[/img]



[h2]2. Current Development Situation[/h2]

[h3]4 Major Regions for the Early Access[/h3]
The early access that will begin this March has 4 major regions of the Secret Forest. These include Jungle, Moon Forest, Desert and part of the main field region.
Currently we’re fine tuning the details for these areas. Other than a few side quests and visual details, the development is complete on all 4 of the major regions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/b6e2855d2c928ef82bd4ae7dc2b448ac91311f46.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/ef2d5aa9c7375448fdd911312ac8c9661947ff9b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/8fdfcaeace5553aa20dd918974037eade28862a2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/16e7ba838681e30d67bac5bb73805777ecf657df.png[/img]



[h3]Housing System[/h3]
The ‘Hero’s House’ located in the ‘Village of the Sun’ now is being renovated for it to be able to be customized.

You may place various housing collectables that are found throughout the adventure. There will be a variety of objects like cooking bonfires, hot springs, pots where you can grow plants and so on. These will let you customize your house to your liking and help your adventure even further.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/35dbf8eae9cb8d4b0653d0f73a667395036fedc4.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/37c514166c84ec594f5e0ecb46d720716decf5f7.gif[/img]



These are the current updates. We are near the first milestone and are very focused for a better player experience. Thank you in advance for being patient with us. Hope you all have a wonderful day!

notes.title: Demo Version Update
notes.content:
Hello! ːsteamhappyː

The early closed beta after the update on June, we've made a lot of improvements. 
Due to these reasons we needed to make several changed to the Demo Version of the game as well.

These are the changes that we made.

[h2]Collectables[/h2]

[h3]1. Bug Catching[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/d4f5369cd32e67d7bfe9232807613516b359636a.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/546fa09d7c4706cad233905e8e25ad637aae3fda.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/5f0468aad7661d1dfdf37b1912c09c2644742b1f.gif[/img]

The 'Bug Catching' system has been included.
Main three types of bugs will be flight, tree and grass. There will be around 30 types of bugs to catch.
These can be sold to the market or exhivited on the 'Museum' which will be updated later.

[h3]2. Monster item drop[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/12bff952b84d477aae87514e53af6a312b639ded.gif[/img]

There will be item drops from the adversaries in the game.
The dropped items can be sold to the market, utilized to upgrade the gear or may be used in various quests.

[h3]3. Timing of Fishing Changes[/h3]

The fishing timing has been improved so the swinging and the catching timing is more reasonable.

[h2]Maps[/h2]

[h3]1. Random Encounters[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/dda3e49d7ae6bd88619c382ffed916b4177c8607.gif[/img]

Random encounter system has been added.
During the Baby Ogu's adventure through various areas of the world, there will be random encounters.
It could either be shops or garbage monsters so that the adventure of Baby Ogu can be more exiting.

[h3]2. Area Graphical changes[/h3]

Many area's artwork images, layers and physics has been improved.

[h2]Puzzles[/h2]

[h3]Pushing Animation Update[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/4d7ccc4a95c071be40610b108148de4e3d1e4f9b.gif[/img]

Most requested improvement during our closed beta was about the pushing system.
The pushing action now has been updated so that the interaction with the object is improved.

[h3]'The Temple of the Sun' Changes[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42365944/a5adc2b6452e92e1564df95020b1b7527cdd9803.gif[/img]

One of the rooms in ‘The Temple of the Sun’ has changed from puzzle to a combat scenario.



[h2]System[/h2]

[h3]'Dancing' Changes[/h3]

Baby Ogu's 'Dancing' ability has been changed to only replenish half of the health bar.
However, there will be a new status effect called 'Exited'.
The 'Exited' status will let Baby Ogu to heal to full health bar as usual.
This status will be acquirable through visiting a town or consuming certain food.

[h2]UI Changes[/h2]

1. Quest UI Changes
Various changes to the UI has been made regarding quests.
Now the undiscovered quests will be noticed. Recently acquired quests and completed quests will be separated.

2. Main Title Theme Music and Image
Title screen's main theme music and image has been updated.

3. Basic Control Changes
Keyboard, Controller, Mobile controls has been changed accordingly.

4. Camera Work Changes While Running Animation
When Baby Ogu is running, the camera will now pan to a wider view.

5. Visual Special Effects
The visual special effects has been added when Baby Ogu's health is low or if there are negative status effects. 

These are the few updates that has been added due to the small portion of the demo version.
We have already developed so much more and we're eager to show you all of it very soon!
We will continue to develop restlessly until early access next year. So that we can give you the best, dynamic and exiting gameplay experience as we can.

Thank you so much!

[/list]
